notes.title: patch 1.0.0.1 - bug fixing
notes.notes: ːsteamthumbsupːFixed: 1) Co-op mode now works, you can start the game when players have joined. 2) Camera shaking for players who have joined. 3) Camera shaking for players who have joined in spectator mode. 4) Day 1 has become easier. 5) Voice chat fixed, previously it worked constantly, now it works when you activate the buttonːsteamthumbsupːAdded: 1) Interaction tips on Day 1.
